recordingCorrections.finding: Initial harness waited only for the edit button, so it did not expose the underlying link-time startup failure.
Strict initialization wait and Network/Log diagnostics exposed the real forbidden /node_modules/yaml/browser/index.js dependency caused by the suite author parser entering the GUI module graph.
recordingCorrections.remedy: The suite structural validation and summary were extracted into a browser-pure contract module; the GUI imports that contract and host node_modules remain private.

recordingCorrections.finding: The probe read offline status directly but expected the already-terminal GUI to receive that response. Terminal GUI tasks stop polling.
recordingCorrections.remedy: Explicitly click the user-visible parent Refresh status control before checking offline button guards; no automatic polling product change.
